spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact shipped surface read from Chromium source: HTMLMenuBarElement/HTMLMenuListElement/HTMLMenuItemElement/HTMLSubMenuElement interfaces, HTMLUnknownElement parse discrimination, menuitem checked/defaultChecked/disabled/command IDL, and invokes the menulist with the popover commands the implementation actually handles (toggle-popover), noting the explainer's proposed toggle-menu is not in the parser yet.

interactive.rationale: Run-probe and constructor buttons produce live table/status readouts in every browser; on flagged browsers the Actions button opens a real menulist popover with an activation log; on unflagged browsers the invoker is explicitly disabled with the reason stated.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature index promises a parse probe plus a button-invoked menulist; the page delivers exactly both, with the honest fallback.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the unsupported branch (HTMLUnknownElement), a disabled menuitem, the constructor path, and distinguishes interface-missing from parse-failure per element.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5206029088063488 plus the WHATWG PR and Open UI explainer.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite mirrors these exact contracts and was verified to execute cleanly and fail honestly (9/9 fail) on unflagged Chromium 141; the pass branch could not be executed because no MenuElements-capable build exists in this sandbox.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 desktop+true-360 mobile verified: probe table renders 4x not-supported, constructor fallback message, invoker disabled, zero console errors, zero horizontal overflow; the supported (flag-on) path is not browser-verified because Chromium 141 predates MenuElements.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts menu-basics-probe-supported on the probe result and reports the fallback branches separately (probe-fallback-honest, native-fallback-honest); fallbacks are never counted as passes.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables, WCAG AA pairs (accent-rose/emerald on paper for verdicts), no button background overrides, focus-visible outlines, no static code-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, labelled probe table, aria-live polite outputs for probe/menu status, role=note banners, and the disabled invoker exposes disabled state instead of silently doing nothing.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280x1800 and at a true 360px viewport via a same-origin iframe harness (headless new mode clamps windows to 500px): documentElement scrollWidth equals clientWidth (0px overflow), controls stack full-width under 640px, 44px tap targets, probe table scrolls inside .table-scroll.

guidanceConsulted.query: popover anchored dropdown positioning dismissal focus
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use the Popover API for tethered overlays (top layer, light dismiss) and do not claim menu semantics without the full keyboard contract.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The demo leans on menulist's implicit popover=auto for top-layer/light-dismiss and documents that the invoking button gets implicit aria-haspopup/aria-expanded; no fake menu roles are added anywhere.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible menu keyboard navigation roving tabindex aria menubar pattern
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keyboard operability, visible focus, and text/live-region equivalents for visual state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are native buttons with :focus-visible outlines; probe and menu state changes mirror into aria-live polite outputs.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give grid items min-width:0 and wrap long inline tokens so intrinsic sizes cannot widen the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .lab > *{min-width:0} and code{overflow-wrap:anywhere} after measuring real 360px overflow; re-measured to 0px overflow.

openQuestions.title: Verify the supported path in a MenuElements-capable Chrome 143+ build
openQuestions.detail: This sandbox's Chromium 141 predates the elements, so only the fallback branch is browser-verified. In Chrome Canary/Dev 143+ with chrome://flags/#enable-experimental-web-platform-features (or --enable-blink-features=MenuElements), confirm the probe reports all four interfaces, the Actions button opens the menulist as an anchored popover, activation closes it, the toggle event fires, and the conformance suite flips to 9/9 pass.

openQuestions.title: Adopt the dedicated toggle-menu command when it lands
openQuestions.detail: The Open UI explainer proposes a toggle-menu command value; Chromium's GetCommandEventType parser does not include it yet, so the demo uses toggle-popover (which html_menu_list_element.cc handles). When toggle-menu lands, update the demo markup and copy, and add a conformance assertion for it.

summary: Parse-probe plus real declarative invocation with honest unflagged fallback. Verified in headless Chromium 141 (desktop 1280 + true-360 iframe harness): 4x not-supported verdicts, constructor fallback, disabled invoker, clean console, zero overflow. Supported-path behavior is derived from Chromium source (html_menu_*_element.idl/cc) and awaits verification on a 143+ flagged build.
